profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am currently a software engineer at Millennial Software.  I am proficient in Python, Rust, Go, and Java as well as full stack development and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-Stack development using programming languages such as Python, Golang, JavaScript and frameworks such as Vue.js and Node.js.

positions.title: Graduate Lab Assistant
positions.description: Instructor for two introductory computer science labs, focusing on the basics of programming and git using Ubuntu, Python, and GitLab.

positions.title: Intern-Software Developer at Knack Works
positions.description:
Worked in an agile environment using the scrum framework developing two web applications: a Kubernetes visualization tool and a filesystem crawler. 

Utilized Python and JavaScript alongside several libraries and APIs such as Apollo GraphQL, Vue.js, React, and the Kubernetes Python Client.
positions.insights: Skills: Apollo GraphQL · Python (Programming Language) · Git · Full-Stack Development · Kubernetes · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Installed software on OS X devices for students and faculty.
- Imaged OS X / iOS devices for faculty and students.
